Stamina is your fitness. It’s full at the most a body your age can be brought to, 99.4 now, so at full fitness it counts as full, and work that reads it asks nothing more. A workout builds it, and holds it for 3 days, and so does a class that trains the body as hard (Movement Invention, stage combat): two a week keep it (Hickson & Rosenkoetter, 1981). Past that it falls 0.18 a day toward 35, what an everyday life keeps (Mujika & Padilla, 2000, on detraining); the rate is SLATE’s. A second workout the same day builds half. It’s the one ability that fades without use: the others keep what they’ve earned.
